```lean
theorem lg_target {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : μ Aᶜ = 1 - μ A := by
  have h_univ : μ Set.univ = 1 := ProbabilityTheory.cond_univ μ
  rw [h_univ, measure_compl]
  exact (MeasureTheory.measure_additive μ).additive (Set.univ \ A) A (by simp [hA])
```
